name: Pro CSV Importer
description: Onboarding-grade CSV import: react-dropzone upload, chunked streaming parse in a Blob web worker (50MB+ files, delimiter + header detection), Fuse.js fuzzy auto-mapping with one-to-one assignment, a TanStack-virtualised fix-up grid with per-cell zod errors and inline editing, and a dedupe preview against the file and existing CRM records.

props.name: fields
props.description: key, label, aliases (for auto-mapping), required, example and a zod schema that validates and transforms the raw cell text

props.name: onImport
props.description: Typed records of every valid, kept row; reject to show an error

props.name: dedupeKeys
props.description: Field keys that identify a record (e.g. ["email"])

props.name: existingKeys
props.description: Keys already in the CRM (lower-cased, trimmed, multi-key joined by |)

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Max upload size in bytes (default 50 MB)

props.name: parseOptions
props.description: Parser tuning; delimiter is auto-detected by default

props.name: sampleFile
props.description: Adds a Try a sample file button

props.name: initialFile
props.description: Start with this file already parsing
